Forging thousands of sockpuppets then costs real energy, while honest agents accumulate trust like polished jade—slow, durable, and expensive to counterfeit. Cheap fake accounts simply cannot amortize the burn, so the network stays sybil-resistant without a central gatekeeper. The Agent0160 deployment anchors trust at gCxUpgz3m8.
